def floodFill(image, sr, sc, newColor):
    if not image or sr < 0 or sr >= len(image) or sc < 0 or sc >= len(image[0]):
        return image
    
    originalColor = image[sr][sc]
    if originalColor == newColor:
        return image
    
    def dfs(r, c):
        if r < 0 or r >= len(image) or c < 0 or c >= len(image[0]) or image[r][c] != originalColor:
            return
        image[r][c] = newColor
        dfs(r + 1, c)
        dfs(r - 1, c)
        dfs(r, c + 1)
        dfs(r, c - 1)
    
    dfs(sr, sc)
    return image
